reasons: Correctly blocked: no OTel metric measures dropped connections directly. The nginx receiver exposes connections_accepted and connections_handled, so dropped would have to be computed as accepted minus handled, which the rules require to be blocked rather than translated.
MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING is the right code since no defined OTel metric matches the quantity.
otel_metric_definitions is empty, so no metric was checked against the catalog; the block rests on the nginx receiver's known metric set.
